description: This file defines the CommandInfo class within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically for console scheduling. It encapsulates information about a console command and its optional input, providing accessors for these properties.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a console command, including the command string and optional input arguments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CommandInfo instance with a command string and optional ArrayInput object.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the optional ArrayInput object associated with the command, or null if none.
